name: Disable Recent Items Tracking
description: Disables tracking of recently opened items in Windows, including recent documents and Start menu suggestions. Existing history entries remain visible until manually cleared.

description_i18n.en: Disables tracking of recently opened items in Windows, including recent documents and Start menu suggestions. Existing history entries remain visible until manually cleared.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Nachverfolgung zuletzt geöffneter Elemente in Windows, einschließlich aktueller Dokumente und Vorschläge im Startmenü. Bestehende Einträge bleiben sichtbar bis zur manüllen Löschung.
description_i18n.fr: Désactivé le suivi des éléments récemment ouverts dans Windows, y compris les documents récents et les suggestions du menu Démarrer. Les historiques existants restent visibles jusqu'à suppression manuelle.

warnings.title: Existing history remains visible
warnings.message: This tweak prevents future tracking but does not remove already existing history entries. Use a separate clear-history tool to delete past records

warnings.title: Explorer refresh
warnings.message: Changes maying Windows Explorer, signing out and back in, or reopening affected apps to take full effect

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Updates current-user Explorer and policy registry values by setting Start_TrackDocs to 0 under HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced, ShowRecent to 0 under HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer, and NoRecentDocsHistory to 1 under HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer
